Marsh Stalker
Large monstrosity, neutral evil
Armor Class 14
Hit Points 68 (8d10 + 24)
Speed 40 ft., swim 40 ft.
STR
17 (+3)
DEX
14 (+2)
CON
16 (+3)
INT
6 (-2)
WIS
12 (+1)
CHA
7 (-2)
Saving Throws DEX +4, WIS +3
Skills Perception +5, Stealth +6
Damage Resistances cold
Damage Vulnerabilities fire
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15
Languages —
Challenge 4 (1,100 XP)
Proficiency Bonus +2
Amphibious. The stalker can breathe air and water.
Legendary Resistance (2/Day). If the stalker fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
Actions
Multiattack. The stalker makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Spit. Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) acid damage.
Legendary Actions
The stalker can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The stalker regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Move. The stalker moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Tail (Costs 2 Actions). The stalker makes one Tail attack.
